payload.reason: The evidence indicates that both radiative forcing and effective radiative forcing are calculated for aerosol-cloud interactions and aerosol-radiation interactions, with explicit consideration of cloud adjustments.

claims.text: The model calculates effective radiative forcing by considering cloud adjustments in aerosol-cloud interactions.
The model is capable of diagnosing both all-sky and clear-sky aerosol radiative forcing, which includes aerosol-cloud interactions.
Aerosol-cloud interactions significantly contribute to the overall radiative forcing estimates in the transport sectors.
